g.text: 5 knob Ø34, bore Ø6 with 4.5 D-flat (?)
Ø30 flat boss on the crown, Ø7 shaft bore
2x copper touch pad 40 x 22 on the inside face - one per shoulder
inset side groove 5.6 wide = module 4 + 2x cloth 0.6 + 0.4 clr
R96 LED field - 21 inside the diffuser edge (unlit fade band)
2x matrix 43.2 x 27.9 butted = 86.4 - posts + clips, no tray
4x Ø2.5 mic port @ 33 - ReSpeaker Flex linear array (?)
5 knob Ø34 x 20 pebble, Ø28 base flat
lip 5 wide, facade 2 behind the rim
(mirrored from FRONT; placed out of projection to fit the sheet)
Ø11 DC barrel jack - UPS 3S charge in (?)
2x 4 vent slot 30 x 2.5 @ 7 - FLANKING the UPS, clear of the Flex
ReSpeaker Flex board 52 x 70 x 20 deep - VERTICAL on this wall, above the UPS
110 envelope - the 3.5 mm jack and the mic ribbon overhang the short edges
lux + barrel jack CENTRED on the width; vents moved to the flanks to stay clear of the Flex board
rear wall: vents, lux, barrel jack
flat top - the crown is a cylinder,
so it only curves in FRONT
front plate + tray separate along Z - see TOP / SIDE
a Third-angle projection, mm, 1:1. (?) marks an unconfirmed value - measure it before you commit geometry.
b THE FORM IS DRIVEN BY THE CRESCENT. The shell arc R129 and the LED crescent R117 are CONCENTRIC about
(129, 60.6), giving a constant 12 mm rim - 8.4 of it on the front plate. The arc radius is W/2, so
the rim is set by W alone: rim = W/2 - 117. Widen the body and the rim widens with it.
c The crown is a CYLINDER, not a sphere - it curves in FRONT only. SIDE is a flat-topped box with an R4 edge break.
d W AND H ARE BOTH DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN. Bottom-up: floor 4 | tray 8-35.9 and speakers 8-53 side by side |
mic array 39.9-51.9 spanning above them | crescent from 60.6. W is then set by the SPEAKER BODY: it has to fit
between the plate edge and the 86.4 tray, so W = 2 x (edge + clr + 50 + clr + half-tray) = 258.
e >>> WIDENING ALSO HEIGHTENS. The arc radius IS W/2, so H = W/2 + 60.6 = 189.6. Every +2 mm of width buys +1 mm of height.
The 110 array is WIDER than the 86.4 tray, so it cannot sit between the speakers - it spans above the whole cluster.
That is the cheaper arrangement: outboard would need W = 220 and a 30 mm rim; above gives W = 258 and a 12 mm rim for 3.5 mm more height.
f Speakers are Seeed Mono Enclosed 4R 5W: a SEALED BOX 50 x 45 x 22, not a bare cone. They clear the tray by 21.9 mm and
the crescent by 4.6 mm and the mic array by 3.7 mm. A wider body grows W and H together.
g UPS 3S BOARD STANDS VERTICALLY. It is a 60 x 93 board and 93 will not lie down in a 59 interior, so the
whole board stands against the rear wall, 24 deep (?). That also puts its 12.6 V barrel jack on the wall that has the cutout.
h Clock zone eats 14.7 of the 64 depth (plate 4 + tray 10.7); ReSpeaker Flex + XIAO sit in the remaining 22.8 mm.
i Charge input is a DC BARREL JACK on the Waveshare UPS 3S board - not USB-C. The only USB-C on the build is the XIAO's own
flashing port, which is internal and needs disassembly to reach (HARDWARE.md). Set the jack height off the as-built board.
j Knob is a full pebble: Ø34 at its widest, cut to a Ø28 flat where it meets a Ø30 boss on the crown.
Blind Ø6 bore x 15 with a 4.5 D-flat. The encoder board mounts to a rib under the ridge.
k ToF sits on the crown beside the knob, board turned LONGWISE front-to-back so its 17.8 edge clears the 25.4 encoder
board by 1.5 mm. Pinhole lands 6.1 mm right of the knob's widest point. Confirm where the chip sits on YOUR breakout -
the drawing assumes it is centred on the board.
l Front plate seats into a rebate in the dome lip (4.5 wide, 3.6 reveal all round).
DOME - 'D' extruded along the depth, open front + open bottom, wall 2.5
FRONT MODULE - one part: facade 4, diffuser pocket, diffusion cavity, matrix pocket, baffle rings, mic channel
BOTTOM PLATE - chassis: ReSpeaker Flex + UPS 3S, 6x M3, 0.3 clearance/side
MATRIX PAIR - 2x IS31FL3731, held by the front module itself
KNOB - pebble Ø34 x 20 on a Ø28 base flat
REFERENCE ONLY - not a released drawing
